_note: Hand-maintained route from docs/07 (phases, owner decisions D1–D8, task list). Edit statuses here as work lands; the console shows days left from dueIso.

phases.label: Ghost
gates: Nightly rehearsal sends what the ledger says

phases.label: Paper
phases.dates: from Mon 2 Nov 2026 · first week in approval mode
gates: No P1 and no reconciliation break

phases.label: Evaluation
gates: Rolling 63-session Sharpe > 0.5 absent a bear market

phases.label: Private build
phases.dates: Jan 2027 build · burn-in Mon 1 Feb → Mon 1 Mar 2027
gates: 20 sessions where the private twin equals the public twin

phases.label: Real money
phases.dates: pilot from Mon 10 May 2027 at the earliest

decisions.title: Sharia policy in writing
decisions.recommendation: AAOIFI SS 21, a ruling on each of the 22 review-flagged names, and the purification method — rule before 30 Oct

decisions.title: Real-money account type
decisions.recommendation: Cash account (no margin agreement), with the settlement guard in R4

decisions.title: Real-money broker
decisions.recommendation: Alpaca live — the same API as paper, so the evaluated path is the traded path

decisions.title: Pilot capital and pain threshold
decisions.recommendation: $10,000–25,000, below the $60,000 estate-tax line; review at −15% from the pilot high

decisions.title: Cold or warm start at each switch
decisions.recommendation: Cold: reset LIVE_START so the twin and the account both start in cash

decisions.title: Ledger remote for the Unraid box
decisions.recommendation: A private GitHub repository (off-site copy, issues for P1s)

decisions.title: When real money starts
decisions.recommendation: After the verdict (Mon 10 May 2027), or a ≤ $5,000 operations micro-pilot from Tue 2 Mar 2027

decisions.title: factor2 as a second paper account
decisions.recommendation: Doc 05 recommends it: the evaluation becomes a live election
